uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

after.properties:
- region "Node — WebServer":
  - heading "Node — WebServer" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": WebServer
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)"
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Node contents":
    - text: Node contents
    - combobox "Deployment child kind":
      - option "Component" [selected]
      - option "Artifact"
    - textbox "Deployment child 1 name":
      - /placeholder: Child name
      - text: AppServer
    - button "Remove deployment child 1": ✕
    - button "+ Component"
    - button "+ Artifact"
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
